params.body: Every version of the identity log is a rotation with both tokens in hand. The maintenance hand and the major-upgrade hand both sign with Elixir's key and neither is in the register yet, so add-key (and replace-key) now take pairs of fragment and key and write them in one version: one ceremony, not two. Rehearsed on a throwaway identity with file keys: version 2 added both roles, verify holds, and adding an existing role is still refused. README updated.
params.title: did-webvh: several roles in one version
